data.description: 【希耶尔 · 圣堂软榻的深情仰卧交付】僻静祈祷室的丝绒软榻上，希耶尔的法衣完全大敞，全身肌肤散发着淡淡的幽香。她仰卧在深蓝软垫上，修长的双腿完全曲起分开，向你袒露出湿润粉嫩的深处。没有眼镜的遮掩，她深蓝色的瞳孔泛着水汽，饱满成熟的丰满雪乳随急促的心跳剧烈起伏，粉嫩乳头挺立泛红。她一手拉过你的手掌与你十指相扣，另一手轻掩唇瓣发出微颤的甜美娇吟——「把我当成普通的成年女性子……狠狠地爱我吧……」

data.promptProse: Blue stained-glass light surrounds adult Ciel lying alone on a padded mat inside a locked church side room. Her dark ceremonial suit and white shirt are open below bare breasts, with one stockinged leg raised and the other folded inward. She holds a page of scripture against her chest with one hand and fingers herself with the other, glasses catching a clean reflection. Indigo hair and amber eyes remain focused through tears and a guilty blush. Vertical solo portrait, no text or extra people.
